title: Supernatural's head of fitness on rebooting the VR exercise app after leaving Meta - Engadget
summary: After Meta announced that it was cutting the company's staff and pausing new content for the exercise app in January Supernatural made the surprising revelation that it will be relaunching later this year as an independent company.
